decisions.reason: Locates the exact expression, identifies busy as a free identifier owned by sibling AttachButton and absent from AttachmentChips's scope chain, and explains the empty-state return null before the map plus the plain-phase falsy guard that forces evaluation and throws ReferenceError.

Explains the render-time throw is caught by the slot-level error boundary which unmounts the entire dock entry (no partial chip output), the attach button in a different slot with its own boundary survives, and the error surfaces only in the console with no UI banner.

Establishes from the shipped v0.2.10 artifact that busy pre-exists v0.2.11, proposes both rollback/re-add bisection and a minimal data-present plain-phase mount, notes the diff's misleading hunk and the imageItem placement inconsistency versus callback-scoped status/record, and avoids claiming exactly when every historical user first exercised the failure.

Proposes removing the dangling reference (or properly owned state in a per-chip component) while keeping the phase guard; hardens record?.items ?? [] and event.target.closest?.() / instanceof Element check, and flags that the imageItem computation must live where status/record are scoped.

Proposes a data-present plain-phase mount test asserting the chip renders and the boundary does not capture, explains the empty-state early return that lets such tests pass and why node --check is a syntax check blind to free identifiers, and requires data-present slot smokes in pre-ship checks.
